title: Ilocos Norte logs 32 leptospirosis cases with 1 death
summary: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A total of 32 leptospirosis cases, including one death, have been recorded in nearby Ilocos Norte this year, according to the Provincial Epidemiology Surveillance Unit…

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A total of 32 leptospirosis cases, including one death, have been recorded in nearby Ilocos Norte this year, according to the Provincial Epidemiology Surveillance Unit (PESU). Of the reported cases, 26 were classified as suspect cases, three as probable cases, and three as confirmed cases. One death was also recorded, based on data released by the PESU. The figures covered the so-called morbidity week 1-35 this year. The Provincial Health Office of Ilocos Norte urged residents to take precautions, particularly when walking through flooded or wet areas that may have been contaminated.
